scope: Stage2-L v13 direct-U/R process-QA LoRA capacity smoke only

observations.exception: RuntimeError: element 0 of tensors does not require grad and does not have a grad_fn
observations.checkpoint_warning: None of the inputs have requires_grad=True. Gradients will be None

root_cause: ORION uses re-entrant gradient checkpointing. The removed bridge used to produce a gradient-requiring conditioning tensor. Under the corrected direct-token architecture, baseline, frozen Stage1 U, and detached R tokens were all gradient-free, so checkpointed decoder segments did not retain a graph for trainable LoRA weights.
scientific_interpretation: This is a fail-closed implementation error, not evidence for or against direct U-token semantics, language learnability, capacity, task relevance, planning, or safety.
authorized_followup: A separately hash-bound v13.1 runtime-fix smoke may use a detached leaf conditioning gradient anchor, which terminates gradients before Stage1/U/R producers, plus a no-update runtime gradient probe before full evaluation. It must use fresh output roots and one new submission per arm.
